That diagnosis is incorrect based on your symptoms. The presence of black spots and decreased vision in one eye without pain strongly suggests an infectious retinitis. Given your history of AIDS, fungal esophagitis, and Kaposi's sarcoma, you are at high risk for Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis. Can you confirm if the vision loss is painless?
